---
title: "Worker writes to stdout after the cell finishes"
format: html
engine: julia
---

```{julia}
# The task outlives the cell, so its output escapes the cell's IO capture and
# reaches the worker's real stdout.
Threads.@spawn begin
    sleep(1)
    print(stdout, repeat("x", 200_000))
    flush(stdout)
end
1 + 1
```
